text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Japan Cup, the second leg
of the Fall Senior Triple Crown.
That race was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Neo Universe, it became a major landmark toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe!
It is Neo Universe!
She swoops right into the center of the circle!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Truly a multidimensional run!
Surpassing Zenno Rob Roy and Hishi Miracle, and then—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What does that wide-open gesture mean?!
Is it a declaration of victory, or total domination?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: At last—I understand.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, Hishi Miracle,
all entities in the venue, the "observers" through the "window"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Only by connecting with everything, at last...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"What matters is――'FELTIE'.
To spread this circle... to infinity."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... "resistance" against the future.
The porthole of the "teardrop-shaped boat" is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It was 'clouded.'
Still...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san! Excellent work out there...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Man, she's strong, seriously strong.
I don't know, it's like her drive is just on a whole 'nother level.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It really was...
By the end, I didn't feel like I could win at all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san, do you have special feelings towards this race?
Of course, the Japan Cup is an important race, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe desired it.
—The "Rods from God."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to protect 'our' future.
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I tried to become the "interceptor."
But that was—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I was... "wrong."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Was I... wrong?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""Connections" extend to everything.
Warm and—infinite."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"We can expand it even further.
Yes, not just for Zenno Rob Roy and the others..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: To both the "Great King" and the "Singularity".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A "singularity"...? Uni-san...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe, who had been in “ABSS” all along,
had lost sight of it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I could only think about leaving Zenno Rob Roy behind.
However...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
We can connect with the "Great King" and the "Singularity" as well.
There is no "event horizon."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe……finally noticed.
――The "love."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the sky, Neo Universe
looked remarkably refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if liberated from something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm not really
sure what's going on, but~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Love really is important, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—3:52 PM.
The Umamusume I sent out has returned.
Her condition is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: It's very Sfera.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was purified life itself.
Emerging from the pitch-black cosmos...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A severe illness, lost bonds, a forgotten friend,
twisted resentment. Having finally overcome all of it..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Today, Neo Universe had 'ANOI'...
Another reason why she wanted to win."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That was—for Trainer's sake.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes. After the Osaka Hai, I couldn't dedicate it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Victory, joy of "MAZN".
We were supposed to achieve it together, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I was supposed to win even in a "foreign land". So...
this Japan Cup, I must win it no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Osaka Hai.
That was... likely something in a different universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the Senior Class Osaka Hai, Neo Universe didn't win a single race. Her overseas expedition was called off too. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, Neo Universe has returned."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To the timeline that was supposed to continue.
"EVEU"... finally...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume who crossed dimensions and returned from the rift of time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Let us now truly welcome
this beloved visitor."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —I'm back.
